## Problem

Answer business questions about sales, customers, deliveries and reviews using about 100,000 orders from the Olist e-commerce dataset.

## Approach

Relational modeling of the dataset and progressively complex SQL queries, from simple aggregations to CTEs and window functions.

## Technologies

[SQL]{.tag} [Relational modeling]{.tag} [Python]{.tag} [SQLite]{.tag} [EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN]{.tag} [RFM]{.tag}

## Results

A 9-table model with primary and foreign keys and 30 versioned queries. Key findings: **17.6% of sellers account for 80% of revenue**, and delivery delays only hurt reviews beyond 7 days (from 4.29 to 1.71 stars).
